name: io.github.gnani-ai/gnani-mcp
description: Official Gnani AI MCP server — Speech-to-Text (Prisma v2.5), Text-to-Speech (Timbre v2.5), Voice Clone, and Batch STT for 10 Indian languages

environment_variables.name: GNANI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your Gnani / Vachana API key (starts with vach_).

environment_variables.name: GNANI_API_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override API base URL for testing/staging. Defaults to https://api.vachana.ai

environment_variables.name: GNANI_MCP_BASE_PATH
environment_variables.description: Base path for audio file outputs. Defaults to ~/Desktop.
